long_biography.plain_text:
Gerardo García Gómez built his international business around specialist reinsurance. With an actuarial background and earlier work advising insurers and reinsurance brokers across Latin America, he developed the company around selected risks rather than undifferentiated scale.

The group expanded into Europe, the Middle East and Latin America while retaining a niche underwriting focus. García moved from chief executive to executive chairman in 2024, leaving daily management to Gary Callaghan while continuing to set strategic direction. He also serves on Grupo Borghese's board, bringing insurance and banking experience to the private holding's portfolio.
